brief.heading: Safety Training People Can Practise.
paragraphs: The Logistic & Warehousing Company asked us for hazard training that is practical and interactive, with progress tracking so managers can see how each employee is getting on.
We answered with one system that has a public website, a training portal for employees and an admin portal for managers. Everything runs in the web browser, so staff do not need to install anything.

delivered.heading: Five Parts, One System.
delivered.note: The screenshots below come from the live system, using test accounts.

items.title: A public company website
items.text: A public website for the Logistic & Warehousing Company that introduces the business, explains its approach to workplace safety and leads staff into their training.
items.alt: Home page of the Logistic and Warehousing Company website with the heading Moving goods. Protecting people.

items.title: A six-level 3D hazard simulator
items.text: Employees explore a 3D warehouse in a 360 degree first-person view, right in the web browser, and click on the hazards they spot. Six levels hold 51 hazards in total, with a timer and a score for each level.
items.alt: Close-up of a spill on the warehouse floor in the simulator, with the aiming dot used to click on a hazard

items.title: An employee training portal
items.text: Each employee signs in to a personal dashboard that shows the training levels, which ones are complete, how many hazards they have found and what to do next.
items.alt: Employee dashboard showing training levels, levels completed and hazards identified

items.title: 78 safety guides and a knowledge assessment
items.text: 78 safety guides, each with a Quick Check to test understanding, and a knowledge assessment that checks what staff have learned.
items.alt: A safety guide page on working at height with a list of guides down the side

items.title: An admin portal with reports
items.text: Managers add employees, follow their progress level by level and download the results as a CSV file or print a training report.
items.alt: Admin training report with completion rate, hazard detection and average score, and a Download CSV button
